en.sayed-ali-raza: 352. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said to one of his companions:

Do not devote much of your activity to your wife and your children, because if your wife and children are lovers of Allāh then He will not leave His lovers uncared for, and if they be enemies of Allāh then why should you worry and keep yourself busy about the enemies of Allāh?
